verses.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
"You must not marry or have sons or daughters in this place."
For this is what the LORD says about the sons and daughters born in this place, and about the mothers and fathers who gave birth to them in this land:

"They will die of terrible diseases. No one will mourn for them or bury them. They will be like manure lying on the ground. They will die by the sword and by hunger, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds of the sky and the wild animals."

This is what the LORD says: "Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal. Do not go to mourn or show sympathy for them, because I have taken away my peace from this people," says the LORD, "my faithful love and my mercy.
Both the important and the unimportant will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned. No one will cut themselves or shave their heads for them.
No one will bring food to comfort those who mourn for the dead. No one will give them a cup to drink to comfort them for their father or mother.
And do not go into a house where there is feasting, to sit with them to eat and drink.

For this is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Look, in this place, before your eyes and in your lifetime, I will put an end to the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom.
When you tell these people all this, they will ask you, 'Why has the LORD announced such a great disaster against us? What wrong have we done? What sin have we committed against the LORD our God?'
Then you will tell them, 'It is because your ancestors left me,' says the LORD. 'They followed other gods and served and worshiped them. They left me and did not keep my law.
But you have done even worse than your ancestors. Look, each of you is following your own stubborn, evil heart instead of listening to me.
So I will throw you out of this land into a land that neither you nor your ancestors have known. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.'
But look, the days are coming," says the LORD, "when people will no longer say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the people of Israel up out of Egypt.'

Instead they will say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the people of Israel up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had driven them.' For I will bring them back to the land I gave their ancestors.

But now I am sending for many fishermen," says the LORD, "and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill and in the cracks of the rocks.
My eyes are watching all their ways. They are not hidden from me, and their sin is not hidden from my eyes.

I will first pay them back double for their wrongdoing and their sin, because they have made my land unclean with the lifeless forms of their hateful idols and filled my inheritance with their disgusting things."

LORD, my strength and my fortress, my safe place in times of trouble, the nations will come to you from the ends of the earth and say, "Our ancestors had nothing but false gods, worthless idols that did them no good.
Can people make their own gods? Those are not gods at all!"
"So look, I will teach them. This time I will teach them about my power and my might. Then they will know that my name is the LORD."
